## Core Services

- [Website Design & Development Kenya](https://charleswebsites.tech/web-design-kenya): Custom business websites, landing pages, redesigns, hosting setup, and maintenance starting at KES 39,890.
- [Custom Software Development & Web Applications](https://charleswebsites.tech/software-development): Bespoke business software, SaaS platforms, CRM/ERP tools, staff attendance systems, and REST APIs.
- [E-Commerce Website Development & M-Pesa Integration](https://charleswebsites.tech/ecommerce-website-development): Online stores with product catalogs, mobile shopping carts, and M-Pesa / Paystack checkout.
- [AI Chatbots & Business Automation](https://charleswebsites.tech/ai-solutions): Grounded AI website assistants, 24/7 lead qualification, and operational workflow automation.
- [Technical & Local SEO Services Kenya](https://charleswebsites.tech/seo-services): Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, Schema.org structured data, and AI search readiness.
- [Graphic Design & Business Branding](https://charleswebsites.tech/graphic-design): Business logo design, brand identity, marketing posters, and social media graphics.
- [Website Packages & KES Pricing](https://charleswebsites.tech/pricing): Starter (KES 39,890), Business (KES 52,660), and custom Premium package comparison.
- [All Services Overview & FAQs](https://charleswebsites.tech/services): Complete overview of engineering, mobile apps, software, branding, and SEO deliverables.
